name: Greek Turkey Burger Patties with Tzatziki Sauce & Greek Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 English cucumber
½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer ½ of the garlic to a medium bowl (that will hold the ground turkey mixture) and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl (that will hold the tzatziki sauce).
Juice the lemon; add ½ of the juice to the medium bowl and the other ½ to the small bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice ½ of the onion and transfer to the medium bowl, then thinly slice the other ½ crosswise and transfer to a salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

To the medium bowl, add the ground turkey, ½ of the feta (save the rest for the salad), Dijon, oregano, salt, and pepper; mix until well combined. Form the mixture into 4 patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.34 kg ground turkey
½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp oregano
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the patties in the skillet and cook until cooked through and golden brown, 4 to 6 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.

Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; coarsely grate ¼ of the cucumber and add to the small bowl with the garlic and lemon juice, then quarter the remaining ¾ of the cucumber lengthwise and cut crosswise into 6-mm-thick pieces. Add to the salad bowl.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl.
To the salad bowl, add the olives, olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp oregano
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add yogurt to the bowl with the garlic, lemon juice, and cucumber; season with salt and pepper and mix together.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the salad and burger patties between plates; top the salad with the remaining feta and serve the tzatziki sauce with the patties. Enjoy!
